capabilities: Chat with the local CodeBuddy CLI in a sidebar panel with multi-turn conversations
Stream responses with collapsible thinking blocks and tool-call cards rendered as Markdown
Inject the current note's path and optional vault path into each message
Persist conversation history across Obsidian restarts and manage multiple conversations
Auto-discover or manually set CodeBuddy CLI and Node.js paths and grant vault write access
extras: Windows-only (macOS/Linux unsupported); README is bilingual (English and Chinese) with detailed setup and troubleshooting tables; MIT licensed; fix notes indicate v1.0.11 addressed streaming and history bugs.
intentEvidence: BuddyBridge is an unofficial Obsidian plugin that connects your vault to the local WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy CLI
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with a local CodeBuddy CLI assistant or use it with vault-aware context inside a sidebar panel.

relations.evidence: Connect Obsidian to the local WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy CLI — an AI chat assistant
connects your vault to the local WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy CLI as an AI assistant

summary: AI chat sidebar that connects the vault to a local CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy CLI with multi-turn streaming, thinking blocks, tool-call cards, and current-note context.
